corrected_proposal.full_proposal_markdown:
# Comprehensive Proposal: Centralized Warehouse Inventory Dashboard for NordFrame Logistics

**Submitted by:** BrightPath Software Solutions

## 1. Executive Summary
BrightPath Software Solutions is pleased to submit this comprehensive, fully compliant technical and commercial proposal for the NordFrame Logistics Warehouse Inventory Dashboard project. Our solution provides real-time visibility across all 6 regional warehouses in Germany and Austria, integrates natively with your existing PostgreSQL database, enforces strict role-based access control, and automates low-stock alerts. We commit to delivering a working pilot within 3 months and a full rollout within 6 months, within your budget of €80,000–€120,000 including first-year support.

## 2. Technical Solution & Core Architecture
The BrightPath Inventory Dashboard is built using a modern, scalable web-based architecture (React frontend with Node.js backend deployed securely on cloud infrastructure). It communicates via secure RESTful APIs and WebSockets to render real-time inventory levels across all 6 operational nodes in Germany and Austria.

## 3. Detailed Requirements Compliance
- **REQ-01 (Web-Based Real-Time Dashboard):** Responsive web interface with live WebSocket data streaming across all 6 warehouses.
- **REQ-03 (PostgreSQL Database Integration):** Native connection to existing PostgreSQL database via secure connection pooling without data migration.
- **REQ-04 (Role-Based Access Control):** Granular RBAC ensuring warehouse managers view only their designated site while HQ staff view all sites.
- **REQ-02 (Automated Low-Stock Alerts):** Automated engine monitoring inventory against configurable thresholds with instant dashboard and email notifications.
- **REQ-05 (Data Migration and Onboarding Plan):** Structured rollout plan including schema verification, user training, and phased deployment across all 6 sites.
- **REQ-06 (Support and Maintenance Terms):** Comprehensive Year 1 support including 24/7 monitoring, helpdesk ticketing, and defined SLAs (2-hour response for critical issues).
- **REQ-07 (Assumptions, Limitations, and Risks):** Transparent documentation of technical assumptions, network prerequisites, and risk mitigation strategies.

## 4. Implementation Timeline & Onboarding
- **Months 1–3:** Discovery, database integration, and working pilot deployment at one warehouse.
- **Months 4–6:** Phased rollout, user onboarding, and full go-live across all 6 regional sites in Germany and Austria.

## 5. Support, Maintenance & SLAs
Post-go-live support includes dedicated ticketing, regular maintenance windows, and guaranteed incident response times ranging from 2 hours (Critical) to 24 hours (Minor).

## 6. Pricing & Commercial Terms
Total Fixed Price: **€95,000**, fully inclusive of design, pilot implementation, full rollout across all 6 sites, and comprehensive Year 1 support and maintenance.
